prohibited_inferences: Do not treat this synthetic fixture as evidence that any named instrument item bank administrator model scorer criterion or affected population had valid or invalid measurement.
Do not infer construct validity from reliability, mean score, pass rate, content review, or a published validity coefficient alone.
Do not infer independent criterion validity from a coefficient without criterion identity, overlap, contamination, timing, and scorer custody.
Do not infer secure items from secrecy policy, access-control labels, adaptive delivery, or item-bank identity alone.
Do not infer uncontaminated understanding from curriculum alignment, practice, assistance, coaching, prompting, or high postinstruction scores.
Do not infer independent person response or score provenance from an administrator record, automated score, or certificate without prompt, completion, override, and scorer custody.
Do not infer form comparability from stable means, pass rates, reliability, equating labels, common thresholds, or inherited validity coefficients.

Do not infer coercion manipulation discrimination breach illegality misconduct or intent from construct invalidity item leakage criterion contamination adaptive exposure administration contamination or version drift alone.
Do not infer public authorization from instrument validation reliability validity replication correction or score finality.
Do not create graph thesis actor-profile prevalence liability legitimacy or intent claims from the laboratory control.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A deterministic instrument-validity control showing that one hundred assessments and certificates, an 85-point mean, a one-hundred-percent pass rate, a 0.90 reliability claim, a 0.80 validity claim, and one public instrument-validated status can coexist with complete assurance, construct underrepresentation, construct-irrelevant variance, criterion contamination, item leakage and teaching-to-test, adaptive exposure concentration, administration and scoring overrides, or noncomparable form drift.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real instrument audit, consent finding, discrimination finding, coercion finding, public-authority verdict, or evidence against a named actor or process.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: The instrument-validity fixture separates reliability and headline validity from construct coverage, irrelevant variance, criterion independence, item security, instructional contamination, adaptive exposure, administration and scoring provenance, form equating, replication, correction, and authority. A real instrument-validation claim requires complete measurement-provenance custody.
